label: Bible Study
prompt: Thy word have I _____ in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verse: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
note: From the longest psalm, all about God's word — memorization as a defense against sin.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh _____.
verse: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
note: James's surprising math: trials test your faith, and the testing produces patience.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a _____ of the ground.
verse: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
note: Abel kept sheep and Cain tilled the ground — the Bible's first two careers, and its first sibling rivalry right behind them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: No doubt but ye are the people, and _____ shall die with you.
verse: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
note: Job's sarcasm to his know-it-all friends: when you die, wisdom goes with you.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the _____ to know his place;
verse: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
note: 'Hast thou commanded the morning?' God asks Job. Zacharias later calls Jesus 'the dayspring from on high' (Luke 1:78).
